summaryZh: Doherty 实验室研究促进哮喘与过敏性气道疾病的肺部固有2型免疫反应，关注调控2型固有淋巴细胞（ILC2）的机制。研究使用动物模型和人类样本。
topics: 哮喘与过敏性气道疾病

evidence.quote: Dr. Taylor A. Doherty is Professor of Medicine and Chief of the Division of Allergy and Immunology.

The Doherty lab has since developed a focus on innate type 2 lung responses that contribute to asthma and allergic airway disease. We have identified novel mechanisms that regulate group 2 innate lymphoid cells (ILC2s) using animal models and human samples.
